summary: Tested recommended-settings, edge-weekly report and Live-Freigabe-Check (edge_readiness) backend + UI. Unit tests: 36/36 pass. New API suite tests/test_recommended_weekly_api.py: 9/10 pass (only failure: non-numeric hour -> 500). UI (1920): diag-edge-readiness shows '5/60 Trades ... Noch nicht bereit: 55 Trades fehlen' with seeded trades, weekly-send button visible for admin and toast 'Bericht erstellt – Telegram aus/nicht konfiguriert', 6 diag-rec-<key> rows, apply shows confirm listing 4 diffs, after accept all rows diag-row-ok + diag-rec-all-ok + success toast. Regression: Edge-Filter selects present (5 ai-edge-filter* controls), no new console errors (only pre-existing 401s before login and visual-editor <span> in <option> warning). 390px: no document overflow; recommended table fits.

minor.issue: Body {hour:'abc'} (or weekday non-numeric) -> 500 Internal Server Error: int() ValueError in edge_weekly.set_config not caught. Should return 400 (or use a Pydantic model).

Manual send writes last_sent (and even when sent=false). is_due() uses last_sent with MIN_GAP_HOURS, so a manual send shortly before Sunday 19:00 suppresses the scheduled weekly report. Store manual sends in a separate field (e.g. last_manual_sent) or only set last_sent for trigger='schedule'.

Labeling inconsistency: by_edge_filter row 'Edge-Filter: besteht nicht' is computed retroactively via bucket_of_trade(config) while Live-Freigabe-Check counts trades marked edge_filter.ok at entry. With seeded trades marked ok:true (no daily_bias), the table shows '5 Trades besteht nicht' right above '5/60 Trades „Edge-Filter besteht“'. Consider preferring trade.edge_filter.ok when present, or renaming the retroactive row (e.g. 'Edge-Filter (rückwirkend)').

issues: Panel content scrollWidth 344 vs clientWidth 322 – the 'EDGE IN R' table (TP1/nötig column) and SETUP-KATALOG table are clipped at the right edge (pre-existing tables, not the new recommended table). Wrap these tables in overflow-x:auto container.

action_items: Validate hour/weekday in POST /api/ai/edge-weekly/config (return 400 instead of 500)
Do not let manual edge-weekly send update last_sent used by the scheduler (or document the behaviour)
Resolve 'besteht nicht' (retroactive) vs 'besteht' (entry marker) labeling mismatch in edge table/weekly report
Optional: overflow-x:auto for diagnosis tables on mobile
critical_code_review_comments: edge_weekly.set_config: int() on raw input without try/except -> 500
edge_weekly.send_report sets last_sent for manual trigger and when Telegram not sent – interacts with is_due gap check
